2. Duplicates superseded by a processed or compressed copy: ~60.0G in 1 path(s)

3. BAM alignment (can be compressed/converted): ~20.0G in 1 path(s)
   why: Final alignments can be stored as CRAM (`samtools view -C -T ref.fa`, roughly 40–60% smaller) once the reference FASTA is archived with it.

4. Trimmed/filtered FASTQ (regenerable intermediate): ~15.0G in 1 path(s)
   why: Regenerable from raw reads with the logged trimming command. Delete once alignments are final.
   before acting: Confirm the producing run finished successfully and its outputs were checked; nothing holds these files open.
   - /data/proj/bob/trimmed/S3_R1_val_1.fq.gz
5. Uncompressed FASTQ (can be compressed/converted): ~5.0G in 1 path(s)
   why: Compress (`pigz -p 8` or `zstd -T8`); aligners and most tools read .gz directly. Typically 3–5× smaller.
   before acting: Convert, validate the new file, and only then remove the original.
   - /data/proj/bob/S3.fastq

Raw data (Raw FASTQ 20.0G) is never a cleanup candidate; archive it to cold storage if space is tight.
